newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 20.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Wednesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Violence erupts at juvenile detention centre.
Chinese Petroleum Corp president Chen Kuo-yung offers to resign to take responsibility for recent accidents.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - President Lee says leaders from Taiwan and communist China should meet at Asia Pacific Economic Cooperation summit.
APEC ministerial meeting begins today (Wednesday) in Philippines.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Council of Labour Affairs to investigate possible illegal hiring of foreign workers by high-tech firms.
Koo Chen-fu, Taiwan's APEC representative, will meet leaders from Philippines, Singapore and Malaysia.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Premier Lien Chan says labour pension funds should be eligible for tax rebate.
Taiwan stock market sets new year high.
